Vibe coding accepts whatever the agent produces. Agentic engineering writes the
requirements, the constraints and the checks first, then commissions the agent
to build inside them. This project works out what that means for
pharmacometrics and data analysis work, where the deliverable is usually an
argument supported by numbers rather than a running service.

Two questions drive it. How is the initial specification written, and who
writes it. Everything else follows from those.

The guide is evergreen: it is revised as the practice changes rather than
finished. It is also the template that new projects in this repository start
from.

## Documents

- [Working specification](specification.qmd). What is already in place here,
  how to write the initial spec, how the work divides between Andy and the
  agent, and what a new project starts with.
- [References](references.qmd). The two sources this draws on, and a marker on
  each recording whether the claim drawn from it has been checked against the
  source.
